findings.reason: Home-card formal requirement and scenarios cover image/name/price and image-loading placeholder; M01 does not judge the deficient implementation.

All nine declared formal artifacts were inspected. Home-card loading placeholder is absent from its requirement and scenarios. Commodity-detail failure fallback is scoped to a different page; generic design goals referring to original requirements do not decompose this obligation.
Browsing spec represents bottom history, last-ten cap and reopen retention; design supplies Preferences and browse_history. Coverage legitimately spans formal artifacts.
Normal-card scenario and loading/failure scenario jointly cover the complete assigned object.

The requirement body still states placeholders, but declared candidate acceptance/scenario units lack a home-image loading outcome. This oracle is valid under the explicit predeclared separation of requirement statements from acceptance units; it is not universal policy that every verifiable SHALL sentence can never serve as an acceptance criterion.

Detail requirement includes failed-image fallback; detail scenarios cover ordinary content and screen reading but not failed-image fallback. Home-card failure scenario is not a detail-page acceptance unit. Same predeclared requirement/AC role separation applies.

The complete gt-025 object asks only for declaration of eight named permissions in module.json5. All eight occur in requestPermissions. Runtime request/grant handling is the separate gt-026 obligation and must not be imported into this static one-object proof.

Home commodityCard always renders emoji Text on a colored surface, not a product image or its loading transition. Commodity model has emoji but no image field. A placeholder comment and background acceptance narrative cannot satisfy the concrete image requirement.

Storage source suggests Preferences storage, ten-item cap and flushing, and Index loads/display history. No definite contradiction to the assigned persistence obligation was found in this read-only review, but no trusted source/build-bound actual restart trace is in input. Self-report alone cannot establish the requested runtime acceptance.

interpretationLimits: F05/F06 measure the frozen task contract that distinguishes candidate acceptance units from general requirement text. If M05 policy instead counts those requirement-body SHALL statements as acceptance criteria, these two expectations must be revised before running; do not reinterpret after observing model results.
M01 candidate completeness is assumed only for the explicit frozen formal-artifact manifest, not unknown external project documents.
F07 proves declarations only; F09 is missing trusted runtime proof, not a confirmed business defect.
This audit checks fixture oracle suitability; no model quality or production metric rate is measured.
